text:
Jules: quick callout: the trace export CTA sits too far right in compact rows; keyboard users can't reach it quickly.
Maya: Could we move primary actions into a single action column with consistent tab order?
Omar: yes. idea: visible actions column with tab stops per row: Copy ID, Reveal, Download. keeps nav predictable.
Jules: copy should always use full canonical id. currently copies visible/truncated string.
Maya: for reveal, avoid hover. use a toggle button with aria-expanded. SR text: "Correlation ID hidden, button reveals full ID".
accessibility-bot: contrast scan: ID pill fails 4.5:1. Recommend using token 'text-on-surface-strong'.
Omar: performance note: retrieving full stack frames for many rows is expensive. lazy-load on reveal, with a loading spinner within the row.
Jules: UX copy tweaks: change button labels to exactly: "Copy ID", "Reveal full ID", "Download snapshot (JSON)".
Maya: export formats: default to pretty JSON for <500 items, otherwise NDJSON with notice. keyboard flow: after pressing Download, open a small modal to choose format if large.
Omar: I'll prototype the lazy-load cap and ensure virtualization still works.
Jules: thanks. I'll update the spec and Figma; will add keyboard walkthroughs.
Maya: assigning a11y review to @accessibility-bot and will run through narrator tomorrow.
